assets.name: Astral Codex
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-oriented cosmetic portrait frame concept for the mobile game Prompt Wars. ONE isolated frame asset, no contact sheet.
Primary request: A fancy premium "Astral Codex" frame, cinematic illustrated game UI: deep obsidian metal, polished violet crystal corner mounts, fine pale-gold calligraphic inlay, a small open-book-and-quill crest integrated into the top rim. Visually rich beveled materials, elegant angular fantasy ornament, violet and pale gold glints, restrained bloom; painterly crisp edges suitable beside stylized fantasy fighter portraits. No character.
Composition: front elevation, perfectly symmetric tall rectangular frame, not tilted, canvas 1024x1536. A large completely empty transparent rectangular portrait aperture occupying central 76% of canvas width and 78% of height, slightly rounded inner corners. Thin side rails, more ornament at top and bottom, all ornaments outside this opening, generous 5% transparent outer padding. Both outside the frame AND inside the opening must be genuinely transparent alpha. Center must contain no image, colored fill, stars, scenery or glass. No solid background or checkerboard drawn into the asset.
Constraints: one complete frame with uncut tips; clear silhouette at mobile size; no text, letters, words, labels, UI buttons, price, watermark, rarity stars, detached objects or large wings. No blur over aperture; do not embed a sample portrait. This is a cosmetic only, no weapon-stat indicators. Actual transparent PNG.

assets.name: Emberforge
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone fancy cosmetic portrait-frame asset for Prompt Wars mobile game, not a contact sheet or screenshot.
Primary request: "Emberforge": a powerful angular frame forged from dark gunmetal and scorched bronze, with four chunky obsidian corner plates, fine molten-orange seams and a small geometric ember crest at top center. Cinematic illustrated fantasy-game rendering, tactile beveled metal, strong graphic silhouette, precise polished edges, controlled amber highlights. Sophisticated, ornamented, premium but legible when small. Match a dark-neutral fantasy arena UI. No character.
Composition: Front-on, symmetric upright rectangular portrait frame on 1024x1536 portrait canvas; inner opening large, straight-sided, slightly rounded corners; clean thin rails on the long sides. Ornament stays on the perimeter. Keep tips comfortably inside the canvas, at least 5% outer margin. Main opening about 76% canvas width and 78% height. Window and exterior background fully transparent, with genuine alpha. No scene or atmospheric haze in the opening. No filled black panel, backdrop, checkerboard pattern, glass or sample portrait.
Constraints: isolated frame only; no text, labels, letters, price, stats, brand logos, watermark; no giant horns or detached flames. Accent only the metal edges with embers; do not obscure the center. The result is a cutout game asset with transparent negative space.

assets.name: Neon Circuit
assets.prompt:

assets.name: Laureate
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE fancy cosmetic portrait-frame asset for Prompt Wars mobile game.
Primary request: "Laureate": a refined champion's frame with satin antique gold rails, sculpted bronze laurel leaves climbing the outer corners, dark emerald enamel details, and a small crossed-quills crest at the top. Game art with beautifully beveled material, controlled highlights, clear graphic forms. Distinguished competitive-arena prestige, more elegant than spiky. Strong silhouette, fine ornament concentrated at the four corners, thin side rails, cinematic illustrated materials that work next to stylized fighter portraits. No portrait.
Composition: front-facing symmetrical tall rectangular 2:3 frame on 1024x1536 canvas. One large empty portrait aperture about 76% width and 78% height, softly rounded inner corners. Maintain 5% transparent outer margins and keep crest fully inside canvas. Nothing intrudes across the aperture. Laurel branches remain tight to the frame, no enormous wings.
Background: genuine transparent alpha inside the opening and outside the frame. No background scenery, vignette, haze, filled panel, glass, shadow field or checkerboard drawn into the image. Standalone transparent PNG cutout of frame alone.
Constraints: no text, letters, price, labels, stat symbols, rarity stars, logos, watermark, presentation board or UI buttons. No crown and no founder insignia.
